skills.name: Mend and Cleanse
skills.description:
Basic Attack

Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

skills.name: Dream Blend
skills.description:
Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend

Lily starts with Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale by default. When Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale is active, press Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG to nearby targets, then switch to Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend.

Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend

When Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm is active, press Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG to nearby targets, then switch to Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend.

skills.name: Into the Dream Cradle
skills.description:
Casting this skill sends Lily into Slumberland and grants her Cradle Lullaby.
Casting this skill also grants Lily a Shield equal to 100% of her Max HP for 4s. This Shield does not carry over to the incoming Resonator.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Slumberland

Lasts for 50s. When Lily is in Slumberland, she heals the nearby active Resonator every 3s. During Slumberland, use directional input to command Dreambind to attack, dealing Spectro DMG to nearby targets. Dreambind pulls in targets within a certain range every 5s while attacking, and stops attacking 10s after movement stops. Press Resonance Liberation again during Slumberland to end it early.
When Lily is in Slumberland and a Resonator in the team other than Lily casts Intro Skill, targets within a certain range are pulled in. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. Lily is immune to interruption during Slumberland and takes 50% less DMG.
Switching to another Resonator during Slumberland keeps Lily on the field but stops the attacks of Dreambind. Lily leaves the field when Slumberland ends, or earlier if she gets too far from the active Resonator. Casting Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom also ends Slumberland immediately.

Cradle Lullaby

Lasts for 25s. While this effect is active, each Intro Skill cast by a Resonator in the team other than Lily grants 1 stack of Dream Aroma. Cradle Lullaby is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator.

Dream Aroma

Stacks up to 4 times. Each stack increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 0.1% for every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190%, up to 7%. This effect is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator or when Cradle Lullaby ends.

skills.name: Woven Scent
skills.description:
Casting Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom additionally restores 10 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale or Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End additionally restores 15 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.

skills.name: Flowers for You
skills.description:
While a nearby active Resonator has 50% or more HP, Lily grants them 10% DMG Reduction.
When a Resonator in the team takes a fatal blow, they will not fall and will instead gain a Shield equal to 10% of Lily's Max HP for 10s. This effect can be triggered once every 5 min.
Casting Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale or Enhanced Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End grants Floral Blessing to Resonators in the team.

Floral Blessing

Lasts for 60s. When the HP of a Resonator in the team is below 50% of their Max HP, restore 50% of their Max HP and remove Floral Blessing. This effect can be triggered once every 120s.

skills.name: Blooming Dream
skills.description:
First Bloom

Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Eternal Bloom

After casting Resonance Liberation - Into the Dream Cradle, Lily's next Intro Skill First Bloom is replaced with Eternal Bloom. When cast, it attacks the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Casting the skill grants Deep Dream Fragrance for 8s. Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm consumes Deep Dream Fragrance to additionally grant 100 points of Dreambell Chime.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

skills.name: Dreamland of Flowers
skills.description:
Dream Perfume

Can hold up to 300 points.
Basic Attack, Mid-air Attack, and Dodge Counter restore Dream Perfume when dealing damage.
Casting Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend or Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend restores 130 points of Dream Perfume.
Casting Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom restores 130 points of Dream Perfume.

Dreambell Chime

Can hold up to 300 points.
Can be gained continuously during Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale and Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm. Any unconsumed Dreambell Chime will be converted into an equal amount of Dream Perfume.

Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale

When Dream Perfume is full, hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale, consuming all Dream Perfume to grant 1 stack of Dream Shelter. During the skill, Lily pulls in nearby targets and continuously deals Spectro DMG to them. She also heals all Resonators in the team every second for 2s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale grants Lily Wish of Praying Dream.
Switching to another Resonator during Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale ends the skills immediately.
Lily continuously gains Dreambell Chime and Concerto Energy (up to 30 points) during the skill.
When Dreambell Chime reaches 300 points, press or hold Normal Attack to end the skill immediately and cast Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale. Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale is automatically cast at the end of Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale. Casting Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale consumes all Dreambell Chime.

Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale

Attack targets within range, dealing Spectro DMG.
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Lily gains Sillage for 6s while casting this skill. Casting Outro Skill consumes Sillage and grants Silvered Dream to Resonators in the team. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.
Lily cannot be switched off while casting this skill.

Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm

When Dream Perfume is full, hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm, consuming all Dream Perfume to grant 1 stack of Dream Shelter. During the skill, Lily pulls in nearby targets and continuously deals Spectro DMG to them. She also heals all Resonators in the team every second for 2s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm grants Lily Wish of Praying Dream.
Switching to another Resonator during Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm ends the skill immediately.
Lily continuously gains Dreambell Chime and Concerto Energy (up to 30 points) during the skill.
When Dreambell Chime reaches 300 points, press or hold Normal Attack to end the skill immediately and cast Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End. Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End is automatically cast at the end of Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm. Casting Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End consumes all Dreambell Chime.

Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End

Attack targets within range, dealing Spectro DMG.
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Lily gains Sillage for 6s while casting this skill. Casting Outro Skill consumes Sillage and grants Silvered Dream to Resonators in the team. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.
Lily cannot be switched off while casting this skill.

Silvered Dream

Lasts for 30s.
When the Resonator with this effect is the active Resonator and can trigger Unison Response, each stack of Unison Boon on the team increases their ATK by 0.1% for every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190%, up to 7%, counting up to 4 stacks of Unison Boon.
The active Resonator's Echo Skill Crit. Rate and Echo Skill Crit. DMG are increased. Every 0.7% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190% increases Echo Skill Crit. Rate by 0.1%, up to 10%. Every 0.7% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190% increases Echo Skill Crit. DMG by 0.2%, up to 20%.
All Resonators in the team gain increased resistance to interruption.

Dream Shelter

Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm grants 1 stack of Dream Shelter, stacking up to 1 time. Dream Shelter is removed when Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale or Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End ends, or when Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm is interrupted. Receiving damage from an enemy target consumes 1 stack of Dream Shelter to grant Lily immunity to interruption and reduce the DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.

Wish of Praying Dream

Can be gained once every 25s.
When Lily has Wish of Praying Dream, the current Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm consumes Wish of Praying Dream to increase the skill's healing by 400%.

skills.name: Skillful Cooking
skills.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: Blooming Fragrance
skills.description: Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Pistols
skills.description: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

sequences.name: Look, White Flowers from the Ruins of Dreams
sequences.description:
Lily is immune to interruption while casting Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale, Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm, Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale, or Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End.
While Cradle Lullaby is active, each Intro Skill cast by a Resonator in the team other than Lily now grants 2 stacks of Dream Aroma.

sequences.name: Listen, a Requiem from the Dream Cradle
sequences.description: While Cradle Lullaby is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lily casts an Intro Skill, each stack of Dream Aroma additionally increases Crit. Rate by 2% and Crit. DMG by 6%.

sequences.name: May Your Soul Wander No More
sequences.description:
Lily additionally gains 170 points of Dream Perfume upon entering combat, triggered once every 12s. When Lily deals DMG with Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom, she additionally gains 170 points of Dream Perfume.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Into the Dream Cradle additionally restores 10 points of Concerto Energy.
Dealing DMG with Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale or Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End additionally restores 10 points of Resonance Energy.
During Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm, Lily gains Dreambell Chime faster.

sequences.name: May Your Past Sink into Silence
May You Find Peace in Endless Light
sequences.description: While Lily is in Slumberland, the pull-in effect range is increased by 50% when a Resonator in the team casts Intro Skill.

sequences.name: May My Reverie Never End
sequences.description:
The Spectro DMG dealt by Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale, Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End is additionally increased by 100%.
The Spectro DMG dealt by Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom is additionally increased by 700%.
